messages:
alex: Quick sync — I'd like to land PR #21112 in tonight's canary slot (22:30 UTC). Need 2 approvals + green CI. Current plan: canary -> monitor 30m -> full rollout.
michelle: I can do one approval once the flaky job is resolved. starting the matrix run now.
release-bot: CI status: pr-21112 pipeline queued (position 8) — estimated start ~12m.
sam: I saw a flaky e2e on mac last run, failing in the auth flow. re-running the single failing job now.
alex: @sam thanks — if it's just the mac e2e we can rerun that stage instead of full rerun. paste the failing log?
sam: ```/home/runner/build/e2e/test_auth.go:45: timeout waiting for element
Expected: visible
Actual: not present after 120s
Screenshot: gs://ci-artifacts/pr-21112/flake-224.png```
jordana: Heads-up — ops has a maintenance blackout window 23:00-23:45 UTC. If we can't verify canary health before 23:00 we should defer to tomorrow.
michelle: mac re-run completed: green. other jobs still running (lint and db-migrations).
alex: Great. @jordana can we still squeeze the canary if we start rollout at 22:30? 30m monitor ends at 23:00 exactly.
jordana: It's tight. If any alerts pop we'll have to rollback manually during the blackout because SRE will be on-call but restricted. I'd prefer a 22:00 start if possible.
alex: Hmm — 22:00 requires us to get approvals and CI done in ~40m. Not sure.
michelle: I can approve now but will hold until all CI green. One approval in the meantime: :white_check_mark: (will add second once DB job passes).
sam: DB migration job is the longest, currently 18m left per logs.
alex: OK timeline: start canary at 22:15 if DB job finishes early; otherwise defer to tomorrow. Can everyone react with :eyes: if they can give the other approval?
jordana: :eyes: I can approve after quick smoke if needed, but prefer defer if any rollback risk during blackout.
michelle: :eyes: will approve once db job green and I smoke locally (5m).
release-bot: CI update: pr-21112 lint ✅, mac-e2e ✅, db-migration in progress (eta 12m).
alex: Thanks. If db finishes in 10m do quick smoke + @jordana approval -> kick canary at 22:15. If not, we hold.
sam: rerun logs look clean. tagging @sre-team for visibility in case of canary.
jordana: Noted. If we go ahead, I'll be on call at 22:15-23:15 to watch the canary. If anything looks off, we'll rollback immediately.
alex: Final plan: wait for db job. If green by 22:05 we start canary 22:15. If missed, defer to tomorrow AM. Thanks all.
michelle: sounds good.
release-bot: CI update: pr-21112 db-migration ✅ at 3420007760 — full pipeline green.
alex: Approved and landing in 10 — thanks everyone. :shipit:
michelle: Approved. :shipit:
jordana: Approved after smoke. I'll watch the canary.
sam: :thumbsup: good luck!
